termZh: 可变字体轴: 光学大小
definitionZh: 使样式适应特定的文本大小。 在较小的尺寸下,字母一般会变得优化,以便更清晰. 体积较大,为头条新闻优化,重量和宽度均较大. CSS中,此轴在可用时会自动激活.
sourceDefinition: Adapt the style to specific text sizes. At smaller sizes, letters typically become optimized for more legibility. At larger sizes, optimized for headlines, with more extreme weights and widths. In CSS this axis is activated automatically when it is available.
